answer_summary:
Synapse Network offers the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling AI assistants like Claude Code to interact directly with Synapse's tools, including canvas, memory, and automations. This integration allows for real-time tool calls with less than 50ms latency and comprehensive audit logs for every call. ([mysynap.com](https://www.mysynap.com/product/mcp?utm_source=openai))

To set up the MCP server, you can use the Synapse Command Line Interface (CLI). The `synapse mcp serve` command starts the MCP server, and `synapse mcp init` initializes the MCP configuration file. ([docs.synapse.sh](https://docs.synapse.sh/operations/cli-usage/?utm_source=openai))

For more detailed information on configuring and using the Synapse MCP server, refer to the Synapse Python/Command Line Client Documentation. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))
